intro: Auckland has numerous gym options across its suburbs, with prices ranging from $10 to $50 per week. From CBD gyms to commuter-friendly options, we've got you covered. In this guide, we'll explore the best gyms in Auckland, including their prices, contract terms, and amenities.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, including Snap Fitness, Anytime Fitness, and City Fitness. These gyms offer a range of equipment, group classes, and personal training services.
